notes.content:

notes.title: Policy Change (1.0.0.1) - Slight rebalance in levels
notes.content:
Hey Workers,

HR is instituting a policy change which fixes typos displayed in savecodes, slightly rebalances the difficulty in levels 3 - 6, and more.

Please read below for more information on this change.

[h2]Policy Change[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed typo displayed in savecodes
[*] Difficulty slightly rebalanced in level 3, 4, 5 and 6
[*] “Bedroom” in the Wire Hub changed for clearer progression, now players need to acquire tea first before they can enter the north wing of the level
[*] Fixed bug where players could still control their character during cutscenes if they triggered the cutscene with 0 energy 
[*] Mimics made a bit more noticeable visually
[/list]
- [The Company]

notes.title: Employee Handbook - Your role at [the company]
notes.content:
Hey loyal laborers,

Thank you for joining our team at the [the company]. Here, we are a family. This handbook will help you with completing your job. If you have any questions or concerns, please feel free to reach out to HR. 

[h2]The Oxygen Tanks[/h2]
Your job is to collect oxygen tanks found around the world left behind in The Facility. These tanks are important to our survival and we can’t waste a single one. Once you find an oxygen tank, please return it to [the company].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45036258/3917f60656b087edc1036741014d3e1a48471e6e.png[/img]

[h2]Managing Your Energy[/h2]
Every action you take will take energy. If you run out of energy, then you will fall asleep during the job. This is unacceptable. Anytime you fall asleep on the job, please submit yourself to HR. If this happens, you will wake up in the last bed you slept at. Sleeping at beds will regenerate your energy and set a new point to sleepwalk once you run out of energy.

Please note, the time you are asleep will be deducted from your pay.

There will be tea left around by someone or something. We strongly advise you to ignore this tea and report it to us if you do find it. We are investigating who keeps leaving these teas around. The energy bonus this tea gives you might seem tempting, but areas of the facility you wouldn't be able to access without this tea are strictly off-limits. [the company] is not responsible for any side effects that may be caused by handling or drinking this tea. If caught with the tea in your possession, you’ll be sent to HR for immediate termination.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45036258/f38795be0bc36c47fd914d769f2e281d6c9c389a.png[/img]

[h2]Tools of your job[/h2]
Here at [the company] we will give you all the tools you need to complete your job. Under no circumstances should you need to use your axe or your handgun– but also, please make sure to bring both the axe on every entrance into The Facility.

[b]Note:[/b] The Facility is perfectly safe and there are no issues whatsoever in it. Under no circumstances should you need to use your axe or your handgun– but also, please make sure to bring both on every entrance into The Facility..
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45036258/f38795be0bc36c47fd914d769f2e281d6c9c389a.png[/img]

All workers are mandated to play the REPOSE demo. Your time used to play the demo will be unpaid and any complaints please send up to HR [for termination process]. 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3002510/REPOSE/ 

- [the company]

notes.title: Akupara Games Publishing REPOSE!
notes.content:
Hey, workers,

[The company] has sent me to update you on some news this month. First off, the employee of the month is Jerry. He has been working very hard and hasn’t suddenly quit yet. Please give a round of applause for Jerry. Remember, we’re like family here.

OK, that’s enough of that. My name is Joseph and I’m the community manager for Akupara Games! I am happy to reveal that we have partnered with Bozó Attila Bertold to publish [i]REPOSE[/i]!
[previewyoutube=zWKMGDfECE4;full][/previewyoutube]

Playing an early build of [i]Repose[/i] was very eerie and figuring out how to make it to the next area with the limited energy you have was very rewarding. I’m so glad we are able to support the developer in the amazing game! Learning about the environment and the…. Wonderful company! Yep! They always care about you and your well being. They definitely don’t have an issue of people dying on the job…

Don’t say anything negative about [the company.] They have eyes and ears everywhere. If I am still alive, I’ll have more exciting stuff to announce from the company later. 

Please wishlist [i]Repose[/i] to make the company family happy.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3002510/REPOSE/ 

- Riv otter
